contea di ritrovamento: North Lincolnshire (Inghilterra e Galles)
D/ IMP C TETRICVS PF AVG

Copper alloy coin. Possibly silver washed radiate, probably of Tetricus I (271-274), Reece period 13. Obverse description: Radiate bust draped and cuirassed right, bearded. Obverse inscription: IMP C TETRICVS PF AVG. Reverse description: possibly a figure, probably with vertical standard or trophy right. Reverse inscription: P[---]G. Diameter: 20.1mm, Weight: 3.36gms, die axis: probably 6
